text:
The reminder service sends **reminder emails** to reviewers. It runs in the
`acme-prod` cluster.
norm: The reminder service sends reminder emails to reviewers. It runs in the acme-prod cluster.

text:
- Team Hermes owns the service.
- On-call rota: see [the rota](https://wiki.acme.test/rota).
  - Nested item with _emphasis_.
norm: Team Hermes owns the service. On-call rota: see the rota. Nested item with emphasis.

text:
| Endpoint | Method | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| /reminders | POST | Schedule a reminder |
| /reminders/{id} | DELETE | Cancel a reminder |
norm: Endpoint Method Purpose /reminders POST Schedule a reminder /reminders/{id} DELETE Cancel a reminder
func Send(r Reminder) error { return mailer.Send(r) }

text: > The service must not send more than one reminder per day.
norm: The service must not send more than one reminder per day.
